native_evidence_per_trial: parent launch stdout/stderr log after process natural exit
copy_rules: Never copy an active starting/pending report as terminal evidence.
Require independently reviewed terminal report plus pre-close sidecar before accepting semantic completion; a zero shell exit is insufficient.
Retain failed native runs and rejected reviews with their actual status.
Copy raw report/sidecar/invocation bytes without rewriting statuses, counts or source maps.
Use a new exclusive evidence directory; if a destination already exists, compare its hash and refuse differing bytes rather than overwrite.
Create a separately named evidence manifest with relative path, size and SHA256 for every copied file; rehash source and destination and require equality.
Keep the manifest own SHA outside that manifest; do not include a self-referential hash.
Treat stdout as active until the parent-owned process exits naturally. Copy it only afterward; archive/cold-stop timing remains separate.
Postclose sidecar may be absent when Kit exits directly; the authenticated pre-close terminal receipt is primary. A postclose sidecar cannot create acceptance.

Do not copy clean_candidate into production as a live overlay or call it the frozen source commit. The source receipt must distinguish base commit, patch hashes, complete candidate byte pins and later release commit.
ABBA_rules: Run semantic first, then four fresh throughput processes sequentially: baseline A1, candidate B1, candidate B2, baseline A2.
All trials use the same authenticated flat checkpoint, v18 recovery worker/design/control, train seed 290927, 4096 population, 600 policy/2400 physics ticks and 4 CPU threads.
Reject unrelated eval-guard changes or any source/contract hash drift in either source root.
Semantic timing deliberately includes vendor comparisons; it is not a throughput result.
Use report.wall_seconds as the native loop metric. Warmed env.step statistics exclude 50 steps and are supplementary, not actor/PPO/whole-run costs.
Record both A endpoints and both B endpoints, variability and any shared-GPU interference. Small gains within variability do not establish acceleration.
No native replay performance result proves full PPO acceleration or behavior quality. Do not grant deployment/skill qualification from this evidence.
later_source_only_release_conditions: After native semantic and throughput review, preserve the candidate bundle and create a clean new release commit from frozen712 using exactly the reviewed core/probe patches.
Bind the new Git source header/archive hash to candidate changed bytes; every contract and unrelated source file must remain exactly frozen712 bytes.
Run required clean CPU and all-role checks against that exact frozen archive; retain the earlier candidate native evidence with an exact-byte correspondence receipt.

Real FixedCaseEnv second-reset and jump whole-body COM coexistence remain separate native coverage requirements before broader use; legacy inspect_v5_activation update hooks are outside this candidate workload.
Use a newly authenticated source-only deployment receipt. Do not reuse source019 launch receipts or its hardcoded 4ba predecessor. The predecessor is actual active712 and its newly sealed fullstate.
Preserve actor/critic/Adam and consumed clocks/origins, avoid warmup duplication, and do not alter worker contracts, curricula, reward, solver or PD timing.
Production remains untouched while evidence is gathered. Only the parent may decide and perform the single graceful stop/seal, owner/lock check and same-contract continuation.
Final packaging/compression must naturally complete. Do not kill finalize or bypass sealing to reduce cold-stop time.
